A dumpling restaurant in the alley before going to Bongcheon-dong Market Street. It hasn't been a long time since its opening, but it's been selling well for years. The dumplings taste not so greasy but light so you can eat a lot…

Although the price is not cheap, it is a place where you can have a glass of wine at night and have a comfortable meal. You can enjoy various draft beer or sake (Japanese traditional rice wine) with yakitori (chicken barbecue).
